intro.title: Investment Platforms
intro.subtitle: Structured Capital. Strategic Growth. Global Reach.
paragraphs: At Instrak Venture Capital Berhad (IVC), our investment platforms are designed to address the diverse capital and strategic needs of corporations, institutions, and high-net-worth investors across global markets.
Each platform is structured with disciplined governance, transparent processes, and institutional-grade execution to ensure long-term value creation and risk-managed growth.

aum.title: Asset Under Management (AUM)
aum.intro: IVC provides discretionary and advisory asset management services tailored to institutional investors, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals.

private-wealth.title: Private Wealth Management – The Luxury Dubai
private-wealth.intro: A premium investment and lifestyle platform designed for ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNWIs) seeking exclusive access to global investment opportunities and high-end lifestyle services.
keyOfferings: Real estate opportunities in prime global locations

share-financing.title: Stock Loan / Share Financing (SL/SF)
share-financing.intro: A structured financing solution that enables publicly listed companies and major shareholders to unlock liquidity using their listed shares as collateral.

equity-financing.title: Equity Financing (EF)
equity-financing.intro: IVC connects growth-stage and established companies with strategic equity investors across global markets.

real-estate-financing.title: Real Estate Financing (REF)
real-estate-financing.intro: A global property financing platform supporting developers, asset owners, and institutional investors.

merger-acquisition.title: Merger & Acquisition (M&A)
merger-acquisition.intro: IVC offers strategic advisory for mergers, acquisitions, and corporate restructuring.

gig.title: Global Investment Gateway (GIG)
gig.intro: A proprietary platform connecting companies with qualified global investors through a curated institutional network.

virtual-cfo.title: Virtual CFO (VCFO)
virtual-cfo.intro: A strategic financial management solution designed for companies that require high-level financial expertise without the cost of a full-time CFO.

asset-insurance.title: Asset Insurance (AI)
asset-insurance.intro: A structured risk-management solution designed to protect high-value assets, investment portfolios, and strategic holdings.

tokenization.title: Tokenization (Tz)
tokenization.intro: A digital asset structuring platform that enables the tokenization of real-world assets for fractional ownership and global investor access.

reits.title: Real Estate Investment Trust (REITs)
reits.intro: Institutional-grade real estate investment opportunities through structured REIT vehicles, offering diversified exposure to income-generating properties.

ppli.title: Private Placement Life Insurance (PPLI)
ppli.intro: Sophisticated life insurance solutions for wealth preservation and estate planning, integrating insurance into global wealth management and tax strategy.
